verdict.rationale: Anytype's Graph is explicitly documented as 'a live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect to each other,' directly matching the interactive knowledge graph story, and linking is described as core to turning notes into a connected knowledge base. Filtering/querying is supported via the Query feature, which lets users define criteria to assemble filtered Views, though docs don't explicitly confirm Query filters apply directly to the Graph visualization itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence that Graph view can be filtered by Query/View criteria, and independent user corroboration of the graph exploration experience.
